'''Wittin''' was a member of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt's]] court on [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> they were present in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] attempted to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] [[Han Solo]] from [[carbonite]].<ref name="RotJ" /> Wittin was a passenger of Jabba's [[sail barge]] the ''[[Khetanna]]'' during the battle that occurred at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> which resulted in the ship's destruction.<ref name="RotJ" />
